title: Easy Yeasty Russian Dough Dumplings
description: A traditional Russian dish featuring tender and light yeasty dumplings with garlic and shio-koji cure, kosher-friendly and delicious. This recipe yields a flavorful and comforting meal.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour, yeast, and salt.
Gradually add the warm water to the dry ingredients and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Preheat a large pot of salted water to 190 degrees Fahrenheit.
Once the dough has risen, punch it down and divide it into 8 equal pieces.
Roll each piece into a ball and then flatten it slightly into a disk shape.
Add the minced garlic and shio-koji cure to the melted butter and brush the mixture onto each dumpling.
Carefully add the dumplings to the boiling water and cook for 10 minutes.
Remove the dumplings from the water with a slotted spoon and serve hot.
